notes.title: New Game Announcement: Usurp - Strategy Party Game
notes.content: [p]Thank you to everyone who gave our game a try, it means a lot to us to have so many people engage with our work. We have a new game coming this fall titled Usurp, a strategy party game set in Han Dynasty China. If you enjoy our games or this type of game piques interest to you, check our game out with the link below and give it a wishlist so you're up to date when it releases.[/p][p]-Mikey, Lead Designer[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3827180/Usurp/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Available Now!
notes.content: Medice To Arms is finally out! We had a couple of bumps along the way and had to delay our release by about a week, but it's out, it's here and we're excited! Expect patches and updates this week as we work out some minor bugs you guys might have. We appreciate all the support and for those of you interested in the latest project or game we're working on, feel free to check out our [url=halfie.ca]website[/url] From all of us at Halfie Studios, thank you and enjoy!
